name: Kirby Survival Economy
description:
Survival with a full player-run economy. You start with $300 in a digital wallet, then earn more from jobs like mining and farming, plus job quests. Put your money in a bank that pays daily interest, and buy and sell through the admin shop, the player Market (with price history), auctions and chest shops. Send items and money to other players by mail, team up in guilds with a shared bank, and protect your builds with shovel land claims. Everything runs from an in-game phone menu, including travel waypoints, kits, a lottery, an arena and elite mobs. Rustic Furniture was just added.

Console players: add the Xbox friend Kirbys Server and join from the Friends tab. The resource pack is required.

Rules: 18+, be respectful, no griefing or hacks, trade honestly. Discord: https://discord.gg/m8DCn8nrx8
